question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Let me redo the query with the CTE included
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        p.name AS top_name,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS path_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.top_id,
        pt.top_name,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.path_qty * pr.qty,
        pt.depth + 1
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id FROM packaging 
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
)
SELECT 
    pt.top_name AS container_name,
    p.name AS item_name,
    SUM(pt.path_qty) AS total_qty
FROM packaging_tree pt
JOIN packaging p ON pt.current_id = p.id
JOIN leaf_items li ON pt.current_id = li.id
GROUP BY pt.top_name, p.name
HAVING SUM(pt.path_qty) > 500
ORDER BY pt.top_name, p.name
